purpose: Controlled class-balanced PAD experiment; prepare a candidate before an explicitly requested webcam trial
architecture: Existing LivenessCNN, RGB112, full crop, random initialization; no pretrained weights
change_from_camera_aug_recipe: Training CrossEntropyLoss uses inverse-frequency class weights N/(2*n_class); validation loss stays unweighted

unchanged_recipe.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation ACER; unweighted validation loss breaks ties

operating_point: After weight selection, minimize validation APCER subject to BPCER <= current runtime validation BPCER. Use no test or camera scores.
limitations: Validation has been reused during development. An improvement is not an independent phone/print/replay result. Resolution-label confounding was not established: full train/validation resolution medians are similar across classes.
command: .venv-gpu/Scripts/python.exe -m anti_spoofing.train --train-manifest data/lcc_fasd_manifests/train.csv --val-manifest data/lcc_fasd_manifests/val.csv --output-dir results/liveness_balanced_20261109 --crop-mode full --epochs 10 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 0.0005 --weight-decay 0.0001 --camera-augmentation --balanced-loss --checkpoint-selection val-acer --device cuda --num-threads 4 --seed 42 --cache-images
